scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.migrate:cloudflare:experiment: npm run check:cloudflare:experiment && npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config cloudflare/wrangler.container-deploy.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:experiment: npm run migrate:cloudflare:experiment && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.container-deploy.jsonc
